arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(status) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,c.idempotency_key,c.state from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select event_id,payload,attempts from outbox where status="pending" order by event_id limit 5
select o.event_id,o.booking_id,o.attempts,o.payload,b.status,b.passenger_id,b.flight_id from outbox o left join bookings b on b.booking_id=o.booking_id where o.status="pending" order by o.event_id

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and o.status="delivered") d from bookings b where k!=1 or h!=1 or d<1
select service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=500 or (status>=400 and service="checkin") order by rowid desc limit 12
select rowid,service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status=504 order by rowid desc limit 8
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by id desc limit 6

select (select count(*) from bookings where status!="confirmed") nc,(select count(*) from bookings b where not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) nk,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op,(select count(*) from charges where state!="captured") ncap,(select group_concat(distinct state) from charges) st
